canonical_serialization.byte_sha256: SHA256 exact serialized bytes; reserialization must equal supplied bytes

real_observer: Read-only docker inspect for exact daemon/proxy/network/image identities, in-container /usr/bin/buildctl debug workers, executable hashes, routes/socket observations and proxy code/policy bytes; no provisioning.
freshness: Observe on every controller preclaim revalidation; provider independently reobserves before any build
synthetic_observer: Qualification-owned local JSON objects plus local policy/code bytes; no assertion about current production topology
historical_TLS_qualification: Frozen 2/2 evidence only; no per-attempt public network probe
